_meta.name: the maintainer's first name is cut from every shipped file, each cut a ledgered substitution; the Ya Diktu PDF keeps its published file name
_meta.not_shipped: the research tree's pilot and set-aside builds (builds/pilot-*, builds/setaside-*), which are not part of C1, and the drafting scratch
_meta.key: the withheld strings are in the maintainer's key, PORT-KEY.json, not shipped; reviewers may ask for it
